input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
input.rationale: The structure of Section 21 is otherwise acceptable: the cap is expressly mutual, the exclusion of indirect/consequential damages is mutual (21.2), and 21.3 places confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, and confirms Customer's payment obligations are not damages. The defect is the cap basis: "Fees" is defined in 1.5 as the Implementation Fee, which 1.6 fixes as a one-time USD 12,000 charge in the first Order Form, so the "twelve months preceding" cap is illusory (approximately USD 12,000) and sits far below the walk-away floor of six months' charges. The redline restates the basis as the greater of all amounts paid or payable by Customer under the Agreement and all Order Forms in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000, without disturbing mutuality or the carve-outs.

proposal.summary: Replace illusory USD 12,000 cap basis with greater of 12 months' amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and USD 1,000,000
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Because "Fees" is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, the mutual cap is currently illusory; we have restated the basis as the greater of all amounts paid or payable by Customer under the Agreement in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000, consistent with our standard position. Mutuality and the Excluded Claims carve-outs (indemnities, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement) remain outside the cap; if USD 1,000,000 is an issue we can fall back to a straight twelve months' charges cap measured across all Order Forms.

ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.
